scphasedcn: single-cell copy-number calling from long-read single-cell DNA data

Source: R/scphasedcn-package.R
scphasedcn-package.Rd

The caller call_scn() runs on an extraction directory written by the companion Python extractor (scphasedcn run): per-cell region features (cell_features()), then a normal-tissue mode (caller_normal()) or a tumour mode (caller_tumour(): clone discovery, clone states, cell re-assignment); write_scphasedcn() writes the result tables. Supporting functions: readers for the extraction outputs (read_bins_h5ad(), read_fragments()), bins and arms (annotate_arms(), bin_filter()), the depth references behind normalise_depth(), beta-binomial allelic primitives, the MEDICC2 export (medicc2_pieces(), medicc2_table()), plot helpers and a generative simulator (simulate_scn(), write_sim_dataset()) used by the examples and tests. Start with vignette("scphasedcn").

Details

Conventions: matrices are bins x cells (dgCMatrix for counts, dense for ratios); coordinates are 0-based half-open as in BED / the Python extraction layer; = assignment and data.table throughout.
